decisions.reason: The click-in track adapter is a low-cost accessory that supports the firm's established track system, so keeping it costs little and preserves value for the existing installed base even though there is little evidence since 2018.

This 2018 LED luminaire was only mentioned in passing and may have been displaced by the newer LED families E and F, but with no clear signal that its value has failed and a low carrying cost within a broad range, keeping it is marginally justified.

Home automation is a strategic growth area where uncertainty about its value remains high, and the server box anchors the firm's control ecosystem, so the option is still worth more than its modest carrying cost.

The luminaire family received its own page, which signals commitment, and premium lighting families usually stay on the market for several years, so without evidence of failure the firm keeps it despite the many other options in its broad range.
